player_prompt.intro:
Wuoyi konywa {difficulty} RushHour puzzle. Lwoko motoka kwa sababu ya kuwachilia motoka nyaming nyakal [X] na kuiendesha nje kwa ukingo wa kulia.
Maamuzi: [A+], [B-], nk.  (+ = mbele, - = nyuma).
